title: Blinking Mobs! [ETF]
description: Mobs will blink occasionally using ETF mod. Villagers and cats will also close their eyes when they sleep.
body:
# Mobs Now Blink!
## Requires Traben's Entity Texture Features mod to work

Using the ETF mod, this pack makes every mob that should blink, blink periodically. It happens very quick (I couldn't get pictures), but makes your world feel that much more alive. Mobs that fall asleep such as Villagers will also have their eyes closed too.

Whenever possible, I sourced textures from Minecraft Dungeons, Earth or any other official media where mobs close their eyes.

### Here's a list of mobs that DON'T blink:
- Axolotl
- Cod
- Salmon
- Tropical Fish
- Pufferfish
- Copper Golem
- Snow Golem
- Iron Golem
- Tadpole
- Slime
- Sulfur Cube
- Magma Cube
- Creeper
- Creaking
- Shulker
- Ghast
- Happy Ghast
- Guardian
- Elder Guardian
- Silverfish
- Warden
- Ender Dragon
- All undead mobs (Zombies and Skeletons blink in MC Earth, however I felt that was weird and left it out)
